# Jinghao Zhao

> Jinghao Zhao (JH Zhao) — ENGINEER & DESIGNER. Software engineer on Google Cloud's GCE Bare Metal team, bringing an end-to-end systems perspective to cloud infrastructure. UCLA Computer Science Ph.D. and Shanghai Jiao Tong University Electronic Engineering B.S., with published research across networked systems, mobile security, and edge and cloud infrastructure.

- Canonical Website: https://zhaojinghao.com/
- GitHub: https://github.com/JinghaoZhao
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=0JvRKBUAAAAJ
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jinghaozhao/
- Full CV: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1w_XJ42SjzV_rB1WRCMU-FlWVH3ZQ_RF9/view?usp=sharing

## Current Focus — Google Cloud · GCE Bare Metal

On Google's **GCE Bare Metal** team, Jinghao Zhao focuses on how dedicated physical machines behave as first-class citizens of a cloud platform—bridging hardware boundaries, automated fleet lifecycle, and predictable fabric performance across the stack:

- **Host & fabric**: Dedicated silicon, high-speed networking, and storage I/O boundaries.
- **Fleet lifecycle**: Automated provisioning, orchestration, and safe control-plane transitions.
- **End-to-end behavior**: Predictable latency, fault isolation, and operability at scale.

### Selected Work — Google Cloud × CME Group (Ultra-low-latency trading)

Jinghao Zhao contributes on the GCE Bare Metal side to the low-latency trading platform built through the Google Cloud and CME Group collaboration, bringing dedicated bare metal compute and deterministic networking to financial markets.

- [Google Cloud Story — Ultra-low-latency solution with U4 enables high-velocity trading](https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/financial-services/ultra-low-latency-solution-with-u4-enables-high-velocity-trading)
- [CME Group Cloud Migration Update (Oct 2026)](https://www.cmegroup.com/media-room/press-releases/2026/10/12/cme_group_announcescloudmigrationmilestones.html)
- *Provenance*: Platform context from public Google Cloud and CME Group materials.

## Education & Research Background

- **Ph.D. in Computer Science**, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), advised by Prof. Songwu Lu.
- **B.S. in Electronic Engineering**, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU).
- **Research Areas**: Networked systems, mobile security, 5G & cellular systems, SIM/eSIM security, mobile edge computing, and edge and cloud infrastructure.
- **Design Interests**: Product interaction and visual aesthetics—clear hierarchy, purposeful motion, and interfaces that make complex technical ideas feel effortless.

## Selected Projects

- [SEED](https://zhaojinghao.com/docs/SEED-A%20SIM-Based%20Solution%20to%205G%20Failures.pdf): Diagnosing and recovering from 5G failures through the SIM (ACM SIGCOMM 2022).
- [SecureSIM](https://dl.acm.org/doi/pdf/10.1145/3447993.3483254): Authentication and fine-grained access control for SIM and eSIM (ACM MobiCom 2021).
- [GPT-Code-Learner](https://github.com/JinghaoZhao/GPT-Code-Learner): Explore a codebase through questions, context, and GPT.
- [Sonica](https://github.com/sonica-nbiot/sonica): An open NB-IoT network for experiments with real devices.
- [Flora](https://project-flora.github.io/Flora/): A software-defined mobile network spanning eSIM, radio, core, and edge.
- [Mobile VR Latency](https://www.usenix.org/system/files/nsdi21-tan.pdf): Proactive LTE uplink scheduling for interactive mobile VR—less delay, more immersion (USENIX NSDI 2021).
- [Acemap](https://acemap.sjtu.edu.cn/): An academic knowledge graph mapping connections across 2,208 research topics and 19 disciplines.
